description: This file declares a struct CookieJarCrypto for encrypting and decrypting data using AES-256 CBC mode, with implementation details for handling cryptographic operations.

classes.name: CookieJarCrypto
classes.description: A struct providing methods for encrypting and decrypting data with AES-256 in CBC mode, including constant parameters and cryptographic routines.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts input data using AES-256 CBC, adds PKCS padding, and outputs encrypted data, setting the version used.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts input data encrypted with AES-256 CBC, considering the version, and outputs the plaintext data.
